blocks.text: iRecover Okanagan is a CARF accredited, abstinence-based drug and alcohol treatment program with locations in Alberta and British Columbia, Canada. The program is designed to offer swift and decisive action, with a rapid access facility that doesn’t require a lengthy wait list or medical referral. The program length ranges from 4 to 12 weeks, and all participants receive personalized care, including 1-on-1 counseling, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), group therapy, and 12-Step fellowship meetings. In addition, participants are provided with a computer tablet pre-loaded with program content, enabling them to access the four live 12-Step meetings available each day, following their treatment.

centre.about_html:
About iRecover Okanagan

iRecover Okanagan is a CARF accredited, abstinence-based drug and alcohol treatment program with locations in Alberta and British Columbia, Canada. The program is designed to offer swift and decisive action, with a rapid access facility that doesn’t require a lengthy wait list or medical referral. The program length ranges from 4 to 12 weeks, and all participants receive personalized care, including 1-on-1 counseling, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), group therapy, and 12-Step fellowship meetings. In addition, participants are provided with a computer tablet pre-loaded with program content, enabling them to access the four live 12-Step meetings available each day, following their treatment. 

Addressing Trauma

The Lavington facility is a 13-bed center that provides an ideal setting for recovery, with stunning views of the mountains. The center employs a unique approach that sees clients work closely alongside their counselors to address a range of physical and emotional challenges, including trauma, health concerns, relationship issues, building self-worth, body image, and identity. The program is designed to create a safe and nurturing environment that promotes lasting recovery and a renewed sense of hope.

Pricing

iRecover Okanagan offers a range of treatment programs to suit different needs and budgets. The medically supervised detox program is priced at $5,200, while the 4-week program is $17,000 + tax, and the 8-week program is $28,000 + tax. The costs include aftercare once the program is completed, ensuring participants receive ongoing support and guidance to help them maintain their sobriety over the long term.

 

iRecover Okanagan - Center Overview

iRecover Okanagan is a renowned rehab center dedicated to helping individuals with substance abuse disorders achieve lifelong recovery. With detox as the starting point, iRecover is designed to provide rapid access to treatment, without the need for doctor referrals or waiting lists, provided the individual has the desire to transform their lives. The facilities have received accreditation and gained a world-class reputation over the past 14 years, transforming the lives of thousands of participants and their families.

iRecover offers a unique approach to addiction treatment using the iRecover program that leverages tablet computers, delivering course materials to individuals during their classroom experience. The qualified and professional staff provides evidence-based treatment in a caring and friendly environment. The program offers specialist addiction treatment in Alberta and British Columbia, with centers located in various parts of Canada. Our commitment to offer a superior quality of safety, confidentiality, respect, and treatment through multiple modalities of addictions recovery informs our approach at iRECOVER TREATMENT CENTERS. After leaving treatment, clients maintain ownership of their tablets, enabling ongoing support and connection with the recovery community.

Frequently Asked Questions About iRecover Okanagan

How is the facility licensed?

iRecover Okanagan is licensed by the Ministry of Health in British Columbia.

What types of addictions are treated?

iRecover Okanagan treats all forms of addiction, including drugs and alcohol.

Can family and friends visit during treatment?

Yes, family and friends are welcome to visit during designated times throughout the program.

What is the age range of participants?

Participants are typically adults, ranging from 18 and older.

Are meals provided during treatment?

Yes, iRecover Okanagan provides healthy and nutritious meals for participants during their stay.

Is the program religious-based?

The program incorporates the 12-Step structure, which has a spiritual component, but it is not religious-based.

About iRecover Okanagan

iRecover Okanagan is a CARF accredited, abstinence-based drug and alcohol treatment program with locations in Alberta and British Columbia, Canada. The program is designed to offer swift and decisive action, with a rapid access facility that doesn’t require a lengthy wait list or medical referral. The program length ranges from 4 to 12 weeks, and all participants receive personalized care, including 1-on-1 counseling, cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT), group therapy, and 12-Step fellowship meetings. In addition, participants are provided with a computer tablet pre-loaded with program content, enabling them to access the four live 12-Step meetings available each day, following their treatment. 

Addressing Trauma

The Lavington facility is a 13-bed center that provides an ideal setting for recovery, with stunning views of the mountains. The center employs a unique approach that sees clients work closely alongside their counselors to address a range of physical and emotional challenges, including trauma, health concerns, relationship issues, building self-worth, body image, and identity. The program is designed to create a safe and nurturing environment that promotes lasting recovery and a renewed sense of hope.

Pricing

iRecover Okanagan offers a range of treatment programs to suit different needs and budgets. The medically supervised detox program is priced at $5,200, while the 4-week program is $17,000 + tax, and the 8-week program is $28,000 + tax. The costs include aftercare once the program is completed, ensuring participants receive ongoing support and guidance to help them maintain their sobriety over the long term.

 

iRecover Okanagan - Center Overview

iRecover Okanagan is a renowned rehab center dedicated to helping individuals with substance abuse disorders achieve lifelong recovery. With detox as the starting point, iRecover is designed to provide rapid access to treatment, without the need for doctor referrals or waiting lists, provided the individual has the desire to transform their lives. The facilities have received accreditation and gained a world-class reputation over the past 14 years, transforming the lives of thousands of participants and their families.

iRecover offers a unique approach to addiction treatment using the iRecover program that leverages tablet computers, delivering course materials to individuals during their classroom experience. The qualified and professional staff provides evidence-based treatment in a caring and friendly environment. The program offers specialist addiction treatment in Alberta and British Columbia, with centers located in various parts of Canada. Our commitment to offer a superior quality of safety, confidentiality, respect, and treatment through multiple modalities of addictions recovery informs our approach at iRECOVER TREATMENT CENTERS. After leaving treatment, clients maintain ownership of their tablets, enabling ongoing support and connection with the recovery community.

Frequently Asked Questions About iRecover Okanagan

How is the facility licensed?

iRecover Okanagan is licensed by the Ministry of Health in British Columbia.

What types of addictions are treated?

iRecover Okanagan treats all forms of addiction, including drugs and alcohol.

Can family and friends visit during treatment?

Yes, family and friends are welcome to visit during designated times throughout the program.

What is the age range of participants?

Participants are typically adults, ranging from 18 and older.

Are meals provided during treatment?

Yes, iRecover Okanagan provides healthy and nutritious meals for participants during their stay.

Is the program religious-based?

The program incorporates the 12-Step structure, which has a spiritual component, but it is not religious-based.
